credential_manager.text: Keeps the device key in Windows Credential Manager and stores account cookies in per-account credential entries. The account file remains encrypted and can unlock automatically on this Windows user profile; clearing or losing the credentials can make the store unavailable.

multi_instance.text: Releases Roblox's singleton mutex so RM can launch more than one RobloxPlayerBeta.exe process. This interacts with Hyperion anti-cheat behavior and may carry account or ban risk.

kill_background_roblox.text: Periodically finds RobloxPlayerBeta.exe processes started with --launch-to-tray and attempts to close them. RM also runs this cleanup before launches; normal game clients are not targeted.

auto_arrange_windows.text: After a launch burst, waits for the clients to appear and arranges attributed Roblox windows using the selected monitor target, layout mode, and padding.

grid_layout.text: Selects automatic square-like tiling, a fixed column count, a fixed row count, an explicit column-by-row grid, one row, or one column.

rename_windows.text: Changes each attributed Roblox window title to its account alias, or username when no alias is set. Titles are visible to other programs and in screenshots or streams; RM restores the original titles when renaming is disabled or the app exits.

launch_delay.text: Sets the minimum pause between successive account launches, including bulk launches. It can be 0-300 seconds and may help when Roblox rate-limits rapid launches from an IP address.

privacy_mode.text: Enables the selected privacy cleanup before each launch. Cleanup is refused while a Roblox client is running; this does not guarantee full account isolation.

privacy_cookies.text: Moves %LOCALAPPDATA%\Roblox\LocalStorage\RobloxCookies.dat into a temporary backup before each launch, then removes the backup after a successful launch. Cookies are enabled by default.

privacy_local_storage.text: Moves the Roblox LocalStorage directory into a temporary backup before launch. It may remove additional local session state and can be restored automatically if launching fails.

privacy_full_profile.text: Moves Roblox user-state directories such as LocalStorage, logs, Downloads, and ClientSettings into a temporary backup. Roblox must be closed before cleanup and the backup is removed after a successful launch.

privacy_on_exit.text: Repeats the selected cleanup when RM exits, but refuses to touch privacy data while a Roblox client is running.

mac_rotation.text: Changes the active Windows network adapter's MAC address using PowerShell. The adapter briefly disconnects, administrator permission may be required, and networks may identify or block a changed address.

mac_preserve_oui.text: Keeps the first three bytes (the manufacturer's OUI) from this PC's active adapter and randomizes only the device portion of the MAC address.

mac_alternate_oui.text: Selects a well-known vendor OUI for the rotated address when preserving this PC's OUI is disabled.

developer_options.text: Adds the Assets tab to the Utility area. Asset uploads create permanent public Roblox assets and are moderated under the account that uploads them.

log_level.text: Sets the app's tracing verbosity for the current build. Only change this if you know what you're doing: debug and trace can generate a lot of log noise and slow down troubleshooting work.

roblox_player_path.text: Optional path to RobloxPlayerBeta.exe, or to its containing folder. RM launches this executable directly; when empty, it searches installed versions under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Roblox\Versions.

encryption_password.text: Switches the account store to password mode. RM derives its wrapping key with Argon2id and asks for this password at startup; forgetting it prevents the encrypted store from being unlocked. Changing it rewraps the store's data key.

confirm_kill_all.text: Require confirmation before terminating all running Roblox instances. Prevents accidental mass-closure of game clients.

refresh_on_startup.text: Automatically revalidate all accounts (check online status, moderation state, presence) immediately after the store is unlocked on startup.

remember_selected_account.text: Restore the previously selected account in the sidebar when RM reopens, instead of defaulting to the first account.

compact_actions.text: Use icon-only buttons for primary actions when available screen width is limited, instead of showing full text labels.

show_update_notifications.text: Display release update link in the top bar when a new version is available.

verbose_launch_diagnostics.text: Include detailed launch and process attribution diagnostics in the application log. Useful for troubleshooting launch issues, but can generate extra log noise.

data_folder.text: RM stores your encrypted accounts, configuration, presets, and cached metadata in this folder. Clearing or modifying files here can break the app; backups are recommended.

privacy_clear_clipboard.text: Clear the Windows clipboard after each successful launch to prevent join history and other sensitive data from lingering in clipboard history.

custom_game_args.text: Pass custom command-line arguments directly to RobloxPlayerBeta.exe. Unsupported arguments may trigger Hyperion anti-cheat warnings; only use if you know what you are doing.

roblox_fast_flags.text: Roblox feature toggles written to ClientSettings before launch. These are experimental Roblox flags and may break games or trigger anti-cheat detection; use at your own risk.

auto_launch_on_startup.text: Automatically launch a selected account when RM starts. This is an attack surface; only enable if RM runs in a restricted or monitored environment.

discord_webhook.text: Sends notifications to a private Discord channel when you launch games or accounts are moderated. You control the webhook URL; rotate it anytime from your Discord server settings. RM never shares webhook URLs or moderation data outside this channel.
